repository.name: pytorch

issue.body:
Fixes #171591

Fixes crash when creating quantized ConvTranspose modules with out_channels <= 0.

Previously these modules would crash with FPE errors. Now they raise a clear ValueError at construction time

body: Hi @KnightGOKU  Is it valid to set out_channels=0? If not, we can simply check its value and terminate normally.
Thanks for the reply @Xia-Weiwen. out_channels=0 is probably an edge case, but right now it crashes. Maybe just adding a simple check and an error handling would make it safer.

> Working on this

Hi @dsashidh Are you working on a PR that adds a check?

Hi @Xia-Weiwen I already submitted a PR that added a check. It checks the value of out_channels and terminates normally with a clear error message instead of crashing. Please see: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/171628
